patronOf.en-US: The Sundays between Christmas and Lent
patronOf.pt-BR: Os domingos entre o Natal e a Quaresma

prayerExcerpt.en-US: All the earth shall bow down before you, O God, and shall sing to you.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Toda a terra vos adore com respeito, e proclame o louvor do vosso nome, ó Altíssimo.

meta.basis: Green is the colour of Ordinary Time (GIRM 346c); the card shows the Sunday itself, the parish gathering for Mass, rather than a moment of the rite, which the parts-of-the-Mass cards paint. The Second Sunday is chosen as the formulary: the First Sunday of the season gives way to the Baptism of the Lord.
